title: A person signs in to Octave's apps with a password and stays signed in until they sign out
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "A viewer signs in with a password ... A device stays signed in until the viewer or the operator signs it out." and "Access is enforced everywhere." The new server has no accounts and no sign-in.
acceptanceCriteria: An operator gives a person an account without an administration screen, and no password is kept in configuration.
A person signs in to a native app with their name and password; the device stays signed in until the person or the operator signs it out.
A failed sign-in says nothing about which accounts exist, and guessing is bounded without locking the real person out.
Nothing the server stores of a sign-in can be used to sign in.
A sign-in belongs to one device and travels in a header, never in a link.
Signing out, an account turned off or removed, and a changed password end that device's sign-in at once on every replica; changing one's own password signs out the person's other devices.
The operator can turn an account off and sign out all of its devices.
notes: Octave Web's sign-in is JS-310 and TV approval JS-311. Invitations, single sign-on, profiles and the device list are stage 4 (JS-326).
